answer: Operator Liability Pool. Each wallet maps to a verified operator; when a cluster of wallets is flagged as one controller, the operator's shared pool pays a penalty scaled to cluster size, not the wallets. A sybil campaign thus drains the pool until it hits its nadir, forcing replenishment or exit. New operators start on an isolated island with capped exposure, and any reward plume from cloned identities is clawed back from the operator, not the clones.
